notes: 1. SM = Sales Manager. SM Admin = a higher-role manager (roleId 4); plain Sales Manager = roleId 5. Admin master OTP = 258369; UAT admin mobile = 8888888888 (master OTP bypasses real SMS on UAT).
2. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable UAT SM record/phone/state (e.g. a brand-new 10-digit phone not yet in the system, or an existing SM id) must be supplied before executing this test.
3. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour not confirmed in BRD/FRD/FS; confirm before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative.

4. SM flags: Assignable (IS_AVAILABLE) controls whether the SM appears in customer assignment dropdowns system-wide; Is Active (IS_ACTIVE) controls whether the SM can log in to the Sales Manager portal. Both take effect immediately across all active sessions.
5. There is NO delete for Sales Managers — they are only deactivated (Is Active = OFF). No DELETE API route exists; deactivation is done via PUT update with isActive=false.
6. Privacy masking (Email / Phone / Cost) is SYSTEM-WIDE — one toggle hides that data from EVERY Sales Manager at once. There is no per-SM masking granularity.
7. SM Admin (roleId 4) is force-set to isAvailable=0 by the backend regardless of the value sent — SM Admins never appear in customer assignment dropdowns / ticket-allocation rotation.

8. Notifications: creating, editing, deactivating an SM, and bulk upload all send NO notification (no email / SMS / push) per FSD-CORRECTION 2026-05-25. Silence is by design — assert that no message is sent. (DOC_DRIFT-005: FRD Feature 7 How-to-Use prose still says "New SMs receive an SMS with login instructions" — this is stale; the corrected behaviour is NONE.)

9. Bulk SM upload lives on a different surface: Config page /admin/cms Section 7 "Sales Managers". The merge key is the phone number — a matching phone UPDATES the existing SM, a new phone CREATES one. Upload accepts .xlsx only.

10. The single Add Sales Manager control opens an Ant Design DRAWER (slide-in panel), not a centred modal — observed in visual-memory (no .ant-modal-content rendered). BRD/FRD/FS call it a "modal"; treat the words modal/drawer as the same Add/Edit panel (DOC_DRIFT-006). Steps below say "Add/Edit panel".
11. The total SM count badge in the header shows the GLOBAL system total and does NOT recompute when the list is searched, column-filtered, or paginated.

12. Destructive / state-changing tests (toggling Assignable / Is Active, creating SMs, masking changes, bulk upload) require user authorisation before running on UAT, and a disposable record where marked.

tcs.expected: Unit pricing is hidden from all SMs.

tcs.scenario: To verify masking is system-wide only
tcs.description: Verify that masking has no per-SM granularity — only system-wide toggles.
tcs.precond: The Settings panel is open.
tcs.steps: 1. Inspect the panel for any per-SM masking option.
tcs.expected: Only system-wide Email/Phone/Cost toggles exist; there is no per-SM masking configuration.

tcs.scenario: To verify masking OFF reveals data immediately
tcs.description: Verify that turning Cost Masking OFF reveals pricing to all SMs immediately.
tcs.precond: Cost Masking ON. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] an SM login + user authorisation.
tcs.steps:
1. Turn Cost Masking OFF.
2. Save.
3. Verify in the SM portal.
tcs.expected: Pricing becomes visible to every SM immediately on next data load.

tcs.scenario: To verify masking save mechanism
tcs.description: Verify how masking changes are saved — auto-save on toggle or explicit Save.
tcs.precond: The Settings panel is open; Phone Masking OFF.
tcs.steps:
1. Click the Phone Masking toggle to ON.
2. Observe whether a save happens automatically or a Save button is needed.
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] [To verify] the toggle either saves immediately (auto-save) or requires an explicit Save/Update click (Q-SM-002). Confirm the save mechanism with the team before changing masking on a live environment.

tcs.scenario: To verify masking state persists
tcs.description: Verify that a masking change persists across an admin logout/login.
tcs.precond: Email Masking just toggled ON.
tcs.steps:
1. Log the admin out.
2. Log back in.
3. Reopen the Settings masking panel.
tcs.expected: Email Masking is still ON — the state persists (stored in the master_configs table).

tcs.scenario: To verify no notification on masking change
tcs.description: Verify that changing a masking toggle sends no notification to SMs.
tcs.precond: The Settings panel is open. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a monitored SM login.
tcs.steps:
1. Change a masking toggle and save.
2. Check the monitored SM for any notification.
tcs.expected: No notification is sent to any SM when masking settings change — the new state simply takes effect on next data load (FRD Feature 6 §8).

tcs.scenario: To verify masking change is audited
tcs.description: Verify that a masking change is recorded in an audit log (admin id, which toggle, new state, timestamp).
tcs.precond: A masking toggle was changed. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] access to the audit log / DB.
tcs.steps:
1. Change a masking toggle and save.
2. Inspect the audit log / configuration history.
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] [To verify] an audit entry records the admin user id, which toggle changed, the new state, and timestamp (Q-SM-005). FRD Feature 6 §9 claims logging — confirm with the team.

tcs.scenario: To verify navigating to bulk upload
tcs.description: Verify that the Sales Managers bulk-upload section is reachable in Config Section 7.
tcs.precond: An admin is logged in.
tcs.steps:
1. Open /admin/cms.
2. Scroll to Section 7 "Sales Managers".
tcs.expected: Section 7 "Sales Managers" is shown with Sample File Download, Upload File, and Submit controls.

tcs.scenario: To verify sample file download
tcs.description: Verify that the sample XLSX downloads with the correct column headers.
tcs.precond: Section 7 is visible.
tcs.steps:
1. Click "Sample File Download" in Section 7.
2. Open the downloaded file.
tcs.expected: An XLSX template downloads with columns: Role, First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone, IS_AVAILABLE, IS_ACTIVE.

tcs.scenario: To verify bulk upload creates SMs
tcs.description: Verify that uploading a file with new phones creates new SMs.
tcs.precond: A filled sample XLSX with new SMs (phones not in system). [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] fresh phones + user authorisation.
tcs.steps:
1. Click Upload File and select the XLSX.
2. Click Submit.
tcs.expected: A success result shows the new SMs as Created; they appear in the SM list.

tcs.scenario: To verify bulk upload updates by phone
tcs.description: Verify that a row whose phone matches an existing SM updates that SM (merge key = phone).
tcs.precond: XLSX has a row with an existing SM phone but a changed Last Name. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] an existing SM phone.
tcs.steps:
1. Upload the XLSX.
2. Submit.
tcs.testData: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] existing SM phone + new Last Name
tcs.expected: The result shows that row as Updated; the SM’s Last Name changes in the list (phone is the merge key).

tcs.scenario: To verify IS_AVAILABLE=0 on upload
tcs.description: Verify that an uploaded row with IS_AVAILABLE=0 sets Assignable OFF.
tcs.precond: XLSX has a row with IS_AVAILABLE=0. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a disposable phone.
tcs.steps: 1. Upload and submit.
tcs.expected: The SM is created/updated with the Assignable toggle OFF.

tcs.scenario: To verify IS_ACTIVE=0 on upload
tcs.description: Verify that an uploaded row with IS_ACTIVE=0 sets Is Active OFF.
tcs.precond: XLSX has a row with IS_ACTIVE=0. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a disposable phone.
tcs.steps: 1. Upload and submit.
tcs.expected: The SM is created/updated with the Is Active toggle OFF (login disabled).

tcs.scenario: To verify per-row upload result
tcs.description: Verify that the upload result reports a per-row outcome.
tcs.precond: A bulk upload with mixed rows was submitted.
tcs.steps: 1. Open the downloaded result file / read the on-screen result.
tcs.expected: Each row is marked Created / Updated / Unchanged / Error with a message. [VERIFY WITH DEV] exact result format (file vs on-screen toast) — [To verify].

tcs.scenario: To verify duplicate email allowed in upload
tcs.description: Verify that two rows with the same email but different phones both process (email is not unique).
tcs.precond: XLSX has 2 rows, same email, different phones. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] disposable phones.
tcs.steps: 1. Upload and submit.
tcs.expected: Both rows process successfully; email is not enforced as unique (Q-SM-001 — duplicate emails observed on UAT seed data).

tcs.scenario: To verify 9-digit phone row errors
tcs.description: Verify that an upload row with a 9-digit phone is flagged as an error.
tcs.precond: XLSX has a row with a 9-digit phone.
tcs.steps: 1. Upload and submit.
tcs.expected: The result flags that row as Error with a phone-validation message; the row is not created.

tcs.scenario: To verify only XLSX accepted
tcs.description: Verify that a non-XLSX file (e.g. .csv) is rejected.
tcs.precond: Section 7 is visible.
tcs.steps:
1. Try to upload a .csv file.
2. Click Submit.
tcs.expected: The upload is rejected with a format error — only .xlsx is accepted.

tcs.scenario: To verify missing-column upload errors
tcs.description: Verify that an XLSX missing a required column is rejected or flagged.
tcs.precond: Section 7 is visible; an XLSX missing the Phone column is prepared.
tcs.steps:
1. Upload an XLSX that omits the Phone (merge-key) column.
2. Submit.
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] [To verify] the upload is rejected or the rows are flagged as Error because the merge-key column is missing. Confirm exact handling with the team — not specified in BRD/FRD.

tcs.scenario: To verify empty-file upload
tcs.description: Verify behaviour when an XLSX with headers but zero data rows is uploaded.
tcs.precond: Section 7 is visible; an XLSX with only headers is prepared.
tcs.steps:
1. Upload the header-only XLSX.
2. Submit.
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] [To verify] the upload completes with zero records processed (or shows a "no rows" message) and no SMs are created. Confirm with the team.

tcs.scenario: To verify no notification on bulk upload
tcs.description: Verify that a bulk upload dispatches zero notifications to created/updated SMs.
tcs.precond: A bulk upload was just submitted. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a monitored phone/inbox among the rows.
tcs.steps:
1. Bulk-upload a row with a monitored phone/email.
2. Check that phone/inbox after Submit.
tcs.expected: No SMS, email, or push is sent to any created/updated SM — bulk import is silent by design (FSD-CORRECTION 2026-05-25). (DOC_DRIFT-005: stale FRD prose claims an SMS is sent.)

tcs.scenario: To verify Assignable SM appears in Customer dropdown
tcs.description: Verify that an SM with Assignable = ON appears in the Customers SM-assignment dropdown (cross-module).
tcs.precond: An SM with Assignable = ON exists. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a customer record whose SM-assignment dropdown can be opened.
tcs.steps:
1. Note an SM with Assignable ON.
2. Open a customer record and open its Sales Manager assignment dropdown.
tcs.expected: The Assignable SM appears as a selectable option in the customer’s SM-assignment dropdown.

tcs.scenario: To verify non-assignable SM absent from dropdown
tcs.description: Verify that an SM with Assignable = OFF does NOT appear in the Customers SM-assignment dropdown.
tcs.precond: An SM with Assignable = OFF exists. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a customer record dropdown.
tcs.steps:
1. Note an SM with Assignable OFF.
2. Open a customer’s SM-assignment dropdown.
tcs.expected: The non-assignable SM does NOT appear as an option in the dropdown.

tcs.scenario: To verify SM Admin force-set isAvailable=0 (API/DB)
tcs.description: Verify that creating an SM with roleId 4 and isAvailable=true still stores isAvailable=0.
tcs.precond: A valid admin bearer token. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] admin API token.
tcs.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/admin/sales-managers/create with {roleId:4, isAvailable:true, ...}.
2. Query the DB / GET the new SM.
tcs.expected: The stored row has isAvailable=0 regardless of input — SM Admins are excluded from ticket-allocation rotation.

tcs.scenario: To verify no DELETE endpoint
tcs.description: Verify that there is no DELETE route for SMs — deactivation is via PUT update.
tcs.precond: A valid admin bearer token; an existing SM id. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] admin token + SM id.
tcs.steps: 1. Call DELETE /api/v1/admin/sales-managers/<id>.
tcs.expected: HTTP 404 (route not found). To deactivate, PUT /update/:id with {isActive:false}. This is an expected limitation, not a defect.

tcs.scenario: To verify SM role cannot manage SMs
tcs.description: Verify that an SM-role token cannot call the SM management endpoints.
tcs.precond: A valid SM JWT (roleId 5). [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] SM token.
tcs.steps: 1. As an SM, call GET /api/v1/admin/sales-managers.
tcs.expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden — only the admin role is allowed. SM Admin (roleId 4) is also denied.

tcs.scenario: To verify inactive SM cannot log in
tcs.description: Verify that a newly created SM with Is Active = OFF is blocked at SM-portal OTP verification.
tcs.precond: A new SM created with Is Active = OFF. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] that SM phone.
tcs.steps:
1. Open the SM portal in incognito.
2. Enter the new SM’s phone, Send OTP.
3. Verify with master OTP 258369.
tcs.expected: Verify-OTP returns HTTP 400 "Your access to the portal has been revoked"; the SM cannot enter the portal.

tcs.scenario: To verify create SM via API
tcs.description: Verify the create-SM endpoint creates a record with the posted fields (happy path, API layer).
tcs.precond: A valid admin bearer token. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] admin token + fresh phone.
tcs.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/admin/sales-managers/create with valid SM fields and a fresh phone.
2. GET the SM list / by id.
tcs.expected: A new SM record is created and returned/listed with the posted First/Last/Email/Phone/Role and the requested isAvailable/isActive flags (for roleId 5).

tcs.scenario: To verify update SM via API
tcs.description: Verify the update-SM endpoint updates an existing record.
tcs.precond: A valid admin token; an existing SM id. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] admin token + disposable SM id.
tcs.steps:
1. PUT /api/v1/admin/sales-managers/update/:id with changed fields.
2. GET the SM by id.
tcs.expected: The SM record reflects the updated fields immediately.

tcs.scenario: To verify unauthenticated list call blocked
tcs.description: Verify that the SM list endpoint rejects a request with no token.
tcs.precond: No authentication token.
tcs.steps: 1. Call GET /api/v1/admin/sales-managers with no Authorization header.
tcs.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized — the endpoint requires a valid admin session/token.

tcs.scenario: To verify expired/invalid token blocked
tcs.description: Verify that an invalid or expired bearer token is rejected by the SM list endpoint.
tcs.precond: An invalid/expired token string. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a tampered/expired token.
tcs.steps: 1. Call GET /api/v1/admin/sales-managers with an invalid/expired Authorization header.
tcs.expected: HTTP 401/403 — the request is rejected.

tcs.scenario: To verify no-session page redirect
tcs.description: Verify that opening the Sales Managers page with no active admin session redirects to login.
tcs.precond: No active admin session (logged out / fresh browser).
tcs.steps: 1. Open https://uat-web.xrportal.in/admin/sales-managers with no session.
tcs.expected: The browser is redirected to the Admin login page rather than showing the SM list.

tcs.scenario: To verify backend phone-validation parity (UI vs API)
tcs.description: Verify whether the create API rejects a malformed phone the UI form blocks (UI-vs-backend split).
tcs.precond: A valid admin token. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] admin token.
tcs.steps: 1. POST /api/v1/admin/sales-managers/create with phone "987654321" (9 digits) bypassing the UI form.
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] [To verify] whether the backend rejects the 9-digit phone (parity with the UI) or accepts it (UI-only validation). Confirm with the team — not specified in BRD/FRD.
